What's included

Two services. Take one or both.

01 — Inside

Interior detail

  • Full vacuum — seats, carpets, trunk, under the seats
  • Shampoo and hot-water extraction on cloth seats and mats
  • Leather cleaned and conditioned
  • Dash, console, vents, cup holders and door panels degreased
  • Pet hair and stain removal
  • Odor treatment — smoke, food, damp
  • Interior glass streak-free

02 — Outside

Exterior detail

  • Foam pre-soak and two-bucket hand wash
  • Wheels, barrels and tires deep cleaned, tires dressed
  • Bug, tar and road grime removal
  • Clay bar decontamination for smooth paint
  • Hand wax or sealant for gloss and protection
  • Trim and plastics restored
  • Glass, mirrors and door jambs finished
